_about: Corpus for scripts/language-detect-check.mjs (plan item 15). Everyday R and Python plotting snippets, made-up data and generic labels only, each labelled with its TRUE language (lang: r | python | null for text that is not R or Python code: prose, a lone comment, another language), its plotting system, and whether the checker supports it. 'supported' follows the public page's own promise: 'R (ggplot2) or Python (matplotlib, seaborn)'; pandas .plot draws with matplotlib, so it counts as supported; base graphics, lattice, plotly, plotnine and altair do not. 'noParse' names why a snippet is not valid source on its own (the harness checks every other R file parses in R and every other Python file parses in Python, so a label cannot be wrong by a typo). A script with 'generated' is not a file here: the harness generates it at run time through the app's own module.
